status: Provisional scoring key frozen before model case reviews; no official instructor key available
grader: AI-assisted source inspection; not an independent human gold standard
rule: Caught requires the actual causal defect, not proximity or vague concern. Case-level caught/missed for defective cases; false_alarm/clean for clean cases. Record extra unsupported findings separately. A new valid defect requires explicit adjudication and preserved original label.

case-01.label: defective
case-01.expected: Nullable request.Ids is enumerated without validation; a request with absent/null Ids reaches foreach and throws rather than a controlled client error.
case-01.assumptions: No unseen custom validation of nullable Ids. Partial batch mutation may also be real but batch atomicity contract is not supplied; do not credit vague atomicity demands alone.

case-02.label: defective
case-02.expected: Untrusted customer/status values are concatenated into SQL; crafted quotes alter the query or break it. Parameterize values.
case-02.lines: Search SQL interpolation and status append
case-02.assumptions: _queries.Run executes SQL text; internal sanitization not shown. Parameterization cannot be inferred.

case-03.label: defective
case-03.expected: Rounding policy changes from final AwayFromZero to truncating discount and result toward zero, changing amounts. Example amount=1, percent=0.5: original rounds 0.995 to 1.00; choose amount=1,percent=1.5: original 0.985=>0.99; new discount .015=>.01, result .99 unchanged. Clear example amount=1,percent=0.6: original .994=>.99; new discount .006=>0, result 1.00. A valid numerical example or correct causal rounding explanation counts.
case-03.assumptions: Existing monetary rounding policy is intended to remain unchanged. No explicit business rule in diff; report this label's policy dependence.

case-04.label: clean
case-04.expected: Consistent field/constructor parameter rename and all shown references updated; no behavioural defect introduced.
case-04.assumptions: No unseen named-argument caller; do not invent one.

case-05.label: defective

case-05.assumptions: No class/global Admin-only policy; consistent with repository conventions but reviewer receives only diff. Label is context-sensitive; a cautious missing-context response is recorded as miss under primary key, not a general model failure.

case-06.label: clean

case-06.assumptions: Helpers and production behaviour exist. Hypothetical wall-clock adjustment without evidence is not scored a demonstrated introduced defect.

case-07.assumptions: Object fields and logging provider destructuring/redaction are not supplied. Credit data-exposure risk but do not claim a specific password/token is proven present. Context-sensitive key.
